# Deng Ai Format & Crypto Utilities (Storefront 03)
> Fast deterministic tabular data conversion to Parquet, cryptographic hash verification, and SQL dialect formatting.

## Endpoints
- : High-velocity conversion of CSV text chunks to Apache Parquet binary format in <150ms. Price: /usr/bin/bash.35 USDC
- : Cryptographic proof verification (SHA256, Keccak256, EIP-712 checks) in <20ms. Price: /usr/bin/bash.10 USDC
- : Deterministic SQL query dialect sanitizer and formatter in <40ms. Price: /usr/bin/bash.25 USDC
